body: Might be related to my issue that it can't find plugin fixtures anymore. Prior to app=>src all worked fine.

- Are you using latest app template?
- What does your app's composer.json look like?
- Please provide your Plugin::load() / loadAll() statement.

I did a composer create-project -s alpha cakephp/app to create the project. However, when inspecting composer.lock it _looks_ like it uses dev rather than alpha, could that be the cause? This is however automagically put in there when using create-project, so maybe the cakephp/app composer.json needs to be updated?
composer.json here: https://gist.github.com/sikker/0ea09b1826946a6d72ac

The boostrap plugin load line is here, as put in automatically by bake:
`Plugin::load('Example', ['bootstrap' => false, 'routes' => false]);`

```
"Example\\": "./Plugin/Example/src",
"Example\\Test\\": "./Plugin/Example/tests"
```

These lines are incorrect. 3.0 now using "plugins" directory not "Plugin"
Perhaps, but I didn't put those lines there, bake did. :)
I am pretty sure bake was updated as per new structure. It's possible composer is giving you a stale version.

well, bake does put the structure correctly in the plugins directory. My plugin directory after bake plugin Example (and creating a ExamplesController just to test) looks like this: https://gist.github.com/sikker/4b8ba85c7e241a282857 so maybe the part where it creates the autoload dump requires an update as well?

It _is_ also possible composer is giving me a stale version somehow, but I find it odd that it's partially correct.
It seems like bake was not updated after the change in the app template. I can get that done

I just deleted my ~/.composer/cache folder and create-project'ed anew to ensure that I weren't recieving stale versions, and the problem persists. Sounds like you found the error though. Making the change you suggested @lorenzo however did solve the problem (after composer update to regenerate the autoloaders of course). Thanks for looking into it. :)
